render_keys(theta, gain, placed=None|int|indices|{i:{pos,ang,scale,alpha}}, omega=0, nsub=8, grooves=True, detune=0)

module.returns: dict(L float32 (1080,1920) straight 0..255, A float32 0..1, tint='warm'); 180 deg shutter integrates nsub sub-frames when omega (rev/frame) is given

field_contract.theta: radians, ccw-positive on screen, from score.json
field_contract.plate_angle_convention: phi in plate frame, image coords (atan2(y,x), y down): 0 = 3 o'clock, increasing = clockwise on screen; phi_screen = phi_plate - theta; offsets in 1x px from the plate centre

eccentric_rule: ring k centre (plate frame) = (11*k*gain, 0) px at 1x, core (77*gain, 0); near-side gap = 15 - 11*gain px (4.0 at gain 1, 7.3 at 0.7). Rings 216..36 px radius, fixed; only the centres drift (user fix: clearly eccentric, centres drifting like duchamp2)

O_A.made: HANDMADE procedural engraved disc, analytic per sample at 2x: 7 eccentric cream rings + grooved core; groove = 1 + 0.14 cos(2 pi d / pitch) about each ring's own centre; ring profile slightly rounded; innermost ring brightest (b 0.90 -> 1.00); camera-fixed convex light upper left (0.86 + 0.22 lambert)
O_A.plate: plate('A'): dark convex, L 18 -> 46 (warm-graded by the editor)

O_B.made: 6 tight eccentric rings of the two GrabCut keys laid tangentially bow-to-bit (bit leads anticlockwise, bow clockwise), K0 iron on even rings (teeth out), K1 bronze on odd rings (teeth in); printed into cream L = (114 + 78*tone) * b * light, b 1.00 -> 0.80 inward; offsets reversed (-5*k*gain px); concave black-card plate('B') L 10 -> 34 with lit side lower right; faint engraved guide grooves (L 46, alpha 0.55, two 1.2 px circles per ring)

plate_continuity: user fix 'one continuous plate tone through the switch': the plate is now a separate camera-fixed, rotation-invariant layer (plate()) and no renderer paints per-ring plate patches. Switch windows should blend plate('text') -> plate('A') (or 'B') with ONE global scalar ramped over the 18 frames, never per-ring region masks.

groove_choice.reason: The brief asked for ~3 px at 2x (1.5 px at 1x). That is above the 1x Nyquist limit (2 px period): at 1x it cannot be resolved, and the crops show a folded checker/moire rather than concentric lines (pitch 1.5 alias RMSE 0.81-0.87 L, contrast is moire). 2.5 px at 1x (5 px at 2x) is the finest pitch that reads as concentric grooves at 1:1, alias RMSE 0.50 L vs an 8x ground truth at both speeds, render/truth groove contrast 8.6/8.2 at 0.30 rev/s and 8.9/8.5 at 0.09375 rev/s. 3.5 px is cleaner (RMSE 0.29) but coarser than duchamp2's fine grooves. It also matches glyphs.py's letter groove (2.5 px at 1x), so letters and rings stay one stock.

measurement.method: 2x render (the film) area-downsampled vs 8x analytic render of the same shutter-integrated rotation, inside the ring interiors; groove contrast = std of the high-pass (L - gauss2) at 1x; crops saved x4 nearest (left = film, right = truth)

section9_measurements.note: cmp_duchamp2_*.png are our frames only (no reference pixels copied); duchamp2 numbers were read with PIL

chosen.O_B: OB_fall_locked: gain 1.0 -> 0.7 (smoothstep), locked orbit, reversed offsets, darker smaller inner rings, concave plate

depth_tests.reason: Locked over detuned: the 2 % detune precesses the core only 0.15 rad (about 12 px) over a 4 s body, so it adds no visible new motion but breaks invariant I1 (rigid rotation of one flat plate) and the exact 80-frame periodicity I5; with a locked orbit every ring returns exactly at k+80. Rising gain for O_A: the core's orbit radius grows 54 -> 77 px, so the stereokinetic cone lengthens while the innermost (brightest) ring is the tip - the approach cue. Falling gain for O_B: the funnel shortens while inner rings are smaller and darker - the recession cue. Rising O_B / falling O_A clips are kept as the comparison.
depth_tests.evidence_label: measured: offsets, orbit radii, periodicity, frame differences. perceptually judged: NOT yet - depth sign was only inspected on still frames by the builder; an independent critic must watch the clips at 1:1 (plan.md acceptance 4). Stereokinetic depth sign is bistable.

key_cutouts.method: optics_keycut.py: mask-seeded cv2.grabCut (GC_INIT_WITH_MASK, 6 iterations), largest component, pin-holes < 1.5 % filled, bow hole kept, 0.8 px feather; asserted: 1 component, bow hole present, >= 2 runs across the bit (teeth kept)
repair_notes: K1 first pass (luminance/saturation seeds only) dropped the near-white specular band of the bronze shank and split the bit; repaired by changing the seed constraints, not the threshold: exact paper (L>=253, S<4) = definite bg (the Commons photo's paper is pre-flattened white), the non-paper region eroded 4 px = definite fg, so the graph cut decides only the boundary band. Result: 0 islands, bow hole 11417 px, notches kept.
K0: the cast shadow at the lower edge is dropped (blue fringe in key0_failure.png); 1 small island removed by largest-component.

notes_for_U2_U3: Ring radii unchanged since the provisional publish: 216 - 30k (k=0..6), core 14 px.
O_B has 6 rings of 15/14/12/11/10/7 keys = 69 slots; map T2 glyphs of turn j to slots of ring min(j,5).
